scope: Disposable Windows Edge accounts and synthetic wallet provider with independently signed EIP-712 messages. No live wallet, deposit, transaction or confidential settlement.
checks: Receive creates a dual-signed ETH link with a 15-minute expiry without changing the Lenz account or requesting a transfer
selecting USDC updates the QR and signed asset, clears the earlier link and preserves the stable wallet address
closing Receive rejects a late wallet signature and clears the shareable link
a recipient link opens without an account, clears the URL fragment and resolves exact address/network before a consented review
a link expiring after review blocks before another wallet request; the receiving account is unchanged
bare addresses require the receiving network; cross-chain destinations stop before wallet reads or transfers
standard EIP-681 wallet links resolve without a Lenz ID or registration
substituted receiving addresses fail before balance, fee or signing requests
